## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (>99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set; second model and neighbors agree.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu >99%, others <1% | One dominant class |
| Conformal set | InSitu only | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 96th percentile | Not flagged; OOD high |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 InSitu | One Invasive neighbor |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 3, 6, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical intraductal atypia; lowers invasive association · Weak [F2]
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Little stromal infiltration detected · Validated [F3]
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Non-tumor background dominates these regions · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 2, 3, 9) · ↑ invasive · Only pro-invasive term here · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions cuts invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown faithful. Mitoses failed spot check (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated JPEG-degraded section with OOD percentile 96; features may reflect artifact.
- Region 11 alone scores 41% invasive; a small invasive focus may hide.

## Check on the slide
1. **3, 6, 8** — Confirm atypical cells stay inside duct walls.
2. **11** — Look for invasive foci; alone it scores 41% invasive.
3. **9** — Check stromal infiltration and mitoses; mitosis concept unreliable.
